$comment: Source of the semantic colors of the macOS app. apps/macos/scripts/generate-design-assets.mjs turns it into Sources/AriadDesignSystem/Resources/Colors.xcassets and the app's AccentColor. Values are sRGB '#RRGGBB' with an optional '@alpha'. lightHighContrast and darkHighContrast default to light and dark. Text colors stay system label colors and are not listed.

accent.use: Selection, primary button, focus ring, links

accentSoft.use: Selected row fill, drop zone tint

onAccent.use: Text and glyphs on an accent fill

thread.use: Progress fill, brand moments, success flash

glassTint.use: Tint over glass and its material fallback

glassFrostFloating.use: Frosted base under floating glass (palette, toasts, action bar, drop card) on the material fallback

glassFrostPanel.use: Neutral near-white frost on light sidebar and inspector panels on the material fallback

shadow.use: Elevation shadow color; opacity comes from the elevation token
